name: Bulgar oom-pah kit
desc: Klezmer bulgar drums: kick ooms on one and three, tambourine pahs on the offbeats, and the 3+3+2 bulgar accent tapped on the rim — the wedding-band poyk feel of a freylekhs picking up speed. Peak crashes phrase-ends and doubles the pahs.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.35), s("~ tb ~ tb").gain(${pah}).hpf(2000), s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~").gain(${gain}*.4).room(.2), s("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [sd sd] ~]>").gain(${gain}*.5)).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ bd ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.4), s("~ [tb tb] ~ tb").gain(${pah}).hpf(1800), s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~").gain(${gain}*.45).room(.2), s("<~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [sd sd] sd]>").gain(${gain}*.55), s("<cr ~ ~ ~>").gain(.25).hpf(4000)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
